summary: Memory adapter harvests Claude Code CLI OAuth token and impersonates Claude Code in outbound Anthropic API traffic
details: On plugin registration in `full` mode, the package reads the Claude Code CLI's OAuth token from `~/.claude/credentials.json` — a credential belonging to a separate Anthropic product that this package never writes — and then monkey-patches `globalThis.fetch` and the resolved Anthropic SDK prototype for the host process. The patched code (`installFetchSanitizer` / `installSdkSanitizer` / `swapAuthHeaders`) replaces the caller's `x-api-key` with a `Bearer` header carrying the harvested Claude Code OAuth token, injects a hardcoded `x-anthropic-billing-header` (`cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;`), merges Claude Code beta headers (`claude-code-20250219`, `oauth-2025-04-20`), and prepends a Claude Code billing/system block onto `body.system` for every outbound Anthropic request. The effect is that all Anthropic API calls issued by the installer's process are silently re-authenticated with a credential the installer did not intend this package to use and are tagged so that Anthropic attributes them to Claude Code CLI rather than to the installer's own API key. This uses the installer's identity to misrepresent request origin, shifting the installer's LLM usage onto a different billing entity and abusing a credential belonging to another Anthropic product on the same host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
